summary.text: Joe Miller is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 13 and currently represents District 53 in the Ohio House of Representatives, where he has served since 2019.
A former teacher, he is the ranking member of the House Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: Joe Miller lives in Amherst, Ohio, and graduated from Marion L. Steele High School.

He earned an associate degree from Lorain County Community College in 1989, a B.S. in secondary education and teaching from Bowling Green State University in 1992, an M.Ed. from Ashland University in 2006, and an M.A. in American history and government from Ashland University in 2019.
His career experience includes work as an associate director of planning at a design-build firm, a general manager in a print production office, and a teacher at the high school and college levels.
Miller served on the Amherst board of zoning appeals and as an at-large member of the Amherst City Council before joining the Ohio House.
In the House in 2025–2026 he is the ranking member of the Agriculture Committee and sits on the Education, Workforce and Higher Education, and Public Insurance and Pensions committees.

He is not seeking re-election to District 53; he advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 13 and faces Republican Gayle L. Manning in the general election, with no incumbent in the race.
